locations.name: Perfect Charter
locations.description: The named, bookable operator behind Jessie Granader's favorite day — a full-day private charter out of Port de Sóller to coves reachable only by boat. Founded 2004, ~20 boats across Sóller, Pollença and Palma, and the #1-rated outdoor activity in Port de Sóller (747+ reviews). A boat day was independently the single strongest signal across every Mallorca source we've gathered; this is the concrete way to book it. Reserve early for the first week of September.
locations.address: Passeig Es Traves, 22, 07108 Port de Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'One of my favorites' — chartered a boat through Perfect Charter out of Port de Sóller, taken to beaches and coves only accessible by boat; crystal-clear water, full day on the water 10–5:30.

locations.tags: anchor-activity, boat, book-ahead, private-charter, snorkeling, swimming

locations.name: Tramuntana Grill
locations.description: The rooftop grill at La Residencia, over the Deià rooftops with mountain and sea views — fire-fuelled, KM0 cooking under chef Guillermo Méndez: grilled meats and light bites at lunch, market-fresh fish and Sóller prawns at dinner. The relaxed, high-view alternative to the hotel's fine-dining El Olivo (which one of our other sources panned), so it's the La Residencia meal to actually book.
locations.address: Carrer son Canals, s/n, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Her first-night dinner at La Residencia — 'a casual dinner at Tramuntana Grill at the hotel, which was incredible.'

locations.tags: dinner, grill, high-end, hotel-restaurant, rooftop, tramuntana, views
locations.geocode_query: Tramuntana Grill, La Residencia, Deià, Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Es Vergeret
locations.description: Cliffside restaurant above the secluded Cala Tuent near Sa Calobra, deep in the Serra de Tramuntana. A big terrace with uninterrupted turquoise-cove and mountain views, known for large shareable paellas and fresh seafood from the bay. Open 10–18 daily; book ahead. Reachable by the boat day or by car down the winding Sa Calobra road — a natural pairing with a Perfect Charter charter.
locations.address: Carrer Cala Tuent, S/N, 07315 Cala Tuent, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Her boat-day lunch stop (the charter's suggestion) — 'a very local restaurant with amazing views.'

locations.tags: boat-accessible, lunch, paella, seafood, tramuntana, views, waterfront
locations.geocode_query: Es Vergeret, Cala Tuent, Escorca, Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Restaurante Sebastián
locations.description: A Deià institution since 1994, set in a 250-year-old former stable with an elegant interior and a lemon garden. Chef Sebastian Pasch cooks seasonal Mediterranean from local markets. A long-standing, well-regarded village dinner spot that fits the quiet, characterful vibe you're after — worth a reservation on a Deià night.
locations.address: Carrer Felipe Bauzà, 2, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Her dinner after the boat day, walking into Deià from the port.

locations.name: Can Costa
locations.description: Traditional Mallorcan restaurant on the Deià road just outside Valldemossa (km 2.5), built around an ancient 'tafona' oil mill with a terrace over the mountains. House specialities are seafood and lobster paella plus meats — suckling pig, lamb, secreto. A neutral single mention from the blog, but a solid, scenic traditional option if you base near Valldemossa/Deià. Free parking; dinner 7–11pm, book ahead.
locations.address: Carretera de Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Her dinner after the morning in Valldemossa.

locations.tags: dinner, mallorcan, mountain-views, paella, terrace, traditional
locations.geocode_query: Can Costa, Carretera Deià km 2.5, Valldemossa, Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Camí dels Pintors
locations.description: The 'Painters' Path' — a panoramic coastal hike out of Deià that Jessie called spectacular and meditative, run along the cliffs and ending right at Ca's Patró March for a seafood lunch on the rocks (~2.5–3 hrs). This is the Mallorca version of the Ravello-to-Amalfi hike you loved: scenic, low-stakes, and it ends at a meal. Pair it with a Ca's Patró March reservation.
locations.address: Cami Son Bujosa, 11, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'Truly spectacular… it truly felt meditative.' A panoramic coastal hike in Deià (~10:00–12:45) ending at Ca's Patró March.

locations.tags: anchor-activity, coastal, deia, hiking, scenic, tramuntana

locations.name: de moniö
locations.description: A tiny, much-loved vegetarian café and concept shop in the heart of Deià (Carrer Felipe Bauzà 1) — celebrated matcha, fresh pastries and cold brews, indoor/outdoor seating with Tramuntana views, plus a curated shop of local ceramics, jewelry and marmalades. The aesthetic morning-coffee stop for a Deià base.
locations.address: Carrer Felipe Bauzà, 1, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'We loved De Monio, a shop & restaurant, for coffee & matcha.'

references.note: Her 4-day base — 'every inch of La Residencia was truly breathtaking,' old-historical-meets-modern with the pool at the heart of the hotel. Arrived 6am, explored Deià, then pool days; the jet-lag-curing massages included 111Skin face masks.
The endpoint of her Camí dels Pintors coastal hike (finished ~12:45): 'one of the most recommended spots… the fresh seafood with high quality olive oil was delicious.'
Her last dinner and 'the best meal of our trip' — the pad thai was 'life-changing' and her Hugo spritz 'crispy and refreshing.'
A morning market visit — 'the town was adorable, however the market was small' (she notes the main market is in Santanyí, ~1.5 hrs away). Found a stall with beautiful shell necklaces.
Her base for the whole trip and 'such a highlight' — 'a popular village that looks like it's out of a postcard,' small but full of amazing restaurants and boutiques.
The departure point for her Perfect Charter boat day (out 10:00, back 5:30), with ice cream at the port on return.
